title: reach out
description: Different doors for different kinds of chaos. Pick the lane that matches what you want to build, hire for, or randomly spiral about.

lanes.label: 01 / team channel
lanes.title: Want me on your team?
lanes.description: For product engineering roles, frontend systems, design-engineering, and fast-moving teams that need someone who can ship clean interfaces with taste.

lanes.label: 02 / build channel
lanes.title: Want to work or consult with me?
lanes.description: For websites, product prototypes, UI systems, launch pages, frontend architecture, and creative technical direction where the brief needs taste and execution.

lanes.label: 03 / weird channel
lanes.title: Want to send a fun DM?
lanes.description: Low-stakes lane for internet artifacts, sci-fi arguments, strange product ideas, music swaps, or anything that feels like it belongs in a group chat at 2am.
